# Geist (vendored)

UI typeface, served from the bundle (`/fonts/`), never from a font CDN.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `Geist-Variable.woff2` | `geist@1.8.2` (`dist/fonts/geist-sans/`) | SIL OFL 1.1, `OFL.txt` |
| `GeistMono-Variable.woff2` | `geist@1.8.2` (`dist/fonts/geist-mono/`) | SIL OFL 1.1, `OFL.txt` |

Copyright (c) 2023 Vercel, in collaboration with basement.studio. The files
are unmodified. The server caches static files as immutable, so a new font
version needs a new file name (and the `@font-face` URLs in
`styles/tokens.css` updated).
